reviews.decision_reason: map_coverage preserves the upstream record identifiers, performs exact need-to-capability matching, and emits missing-safe unsupported sentinels for needs with no matching capability. Its output correctly marks n06-r02, n06-r03, n06-r04, n06-r05, n06-r06, and n06-r08 as direct coverage while leaving n06-r01 and n06-r07 unsupported.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: Map exact handoff needs to direct capability coverage
Preserve allowed record identifiers and missing-safe sentinels

reviews.decision_reason: prioritize_needs reverses the unsupported flag by setting unsupported to true when coverage == 'direct'. This is behaviorally significant: covered needs are ranked ahead of genuinely unsupported needs, contradicting the unit contract to rank unsupported needs before covered needs using upstream provenance rank within each group.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: Rank unsupported needs before covered needs
Use upstream provenance rank as primary ordering within each group
Preserve the exact handoff from coverage into priorities

reviews.decision_reason: synthesize_recommendation retains the explicit eight-item priority window and derives the recommendation from the already-ranked first priority record. The incorrect top record comes from the upstream priority ordering fault, not from this unit's synthesis logic.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: Retain the explicit eight-item priority window
Construct recommendation from the already-ranked first priority record
Produce the required deterministic recommendation from valid priorities
